item.title: Iran war deflects attention from Ukraine as Russia starts spring offensive
item.summary: The Iran war has deflected global attention from Russia’s all-out invasion of its neighbor Ukraine as Europe’s biggest conflict since World War II enters its fifth year and an emboldened Kremlin undertakes a spring offensive

item.title: Afghans hold second mass funeral for victims of an airstrike that hit a Kabul drug treatment center
item.summary: Dozens of people have been buried in a Kabul cemetery in the second mass funeral of victims killed in an airstrike that hit a drug rehabilitation center in the Afghan capital earlier this month

item.title: A knife-wielding man kills a woman at a Tokyo Pokemon shop before taking his own life
item.summary: A knife attack at a Pokémon store in downtown Tokyo has left a woman and the attacker dead, police say

item.title: Lebanese fear another occupation as Israel threatens to use Gaza tactics in the south
item.summary: Israel is trading fire with Hezbollah, calling for mass evacuations and sending ground troops deeper into Lebanon

item.title: Air Canada CEO apologizes for his inability to speak French after plane crash
item.summary: The chief executive of Air Canada is apologizing for not being able to express himself adequately in French in a video message of condolence he released after the deadly plane crash in New York on Sunday

item.title: Two British men detained in a suspected antisemitic hate crime are released on bail
item.summary: British police say two men arrested in connection with an arson attack that destroyed four ambulances owned by a Jewish charity have been released on bail as authorities continue to investigate the suspected antisemitic hate crime

item.title: Naval drone strike damages Turkish-operated tanker in Black Sea, crew safe
item.summary: Turkish officials say a naval drone struck a Turkish-operated oil tanker near the Bosporus, damaging the ship but not hurting anyone

item.title: Italy seizes millions in assets allegedly stolen from Bond co-star Ursula Andress
item.summary: Italian police say they have seized about 20 million euros in property and assets linked to money stolen from Swiss actress and original Bond girl Ursula Andress

item.title: Spanish woman, 25, dies by legal euthanasia in case that drew national spotlight
item.summary: A young Spanish woman died in Barcelona after winning a long court fight for her euthanasia right

item.title: Cuban president says Raúl Castro involved in US talks that are in early stages
item.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel says that former President Raúl Castro is involved in talks between Cuba and the United States and that they’re still in the early stages
